title: Fix the two existing tests no Step owns in a named fix-up commit after wave 1
context: Lane 2's spec'd change breaks two existing tests that no wave 1 Step lists. test/design/design_kit_dark_test.dart asserts the old solid dark toast pill. test/app/shell/petal_layer_test.dart asserts ShellContent is smaller than the window, but the phone body is now full-bleed. Wave 2's petal-pace only edits petal_layer_test where it counted the old narrow petals. Editing the items now would change the plan id, and mitosis refuses to resume against a changed plan. A stray edit left in the worktree before the resume would be swept into a Lane commit.
options: Change the items to give a Step these files, which changes the plan id and forfeits the run's finished Lanes
Edit them in the worktree now and let mitosis sweep them into a Lane or MSP commit
After wave 1 finishes, make one named fix-up commit on mitosis/proto-phone-shell, then run the full suite, and name the commit in the PR body
outcome: I'll make one named fix-up commit on mitosis/proto-phone-shell after the wave 1 run exits and before the full suite. It changes the design kit dark toast check to the glass toast (GlassSurface with tone toast, text #fbf3e4), and limits petal_layer_test's ShellContent-smaller-than-window check to ShellLayout.sidebar. The PR body and the thread will name the commit, so the reviewer sees it was made outside mitosis.
